title: Solution Guardrails Catalogue
description: Catalogue of non-negotiable constraints, mandatory standards, and concrete patterns for the Solution architecture domain. Aligned to Policy-as-Code conventions (AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy).

meta.description: Rules and minimum standards that must be followed in Solution Architecture.
purpose: Prevents solution designs that violate constraints from multiple contributing domains
Provides enforcement criteria that span the full architecture at the point of delivery
Codifies the minimum quality bar for cross-domain solution review
Enables automated guardrail checking for solutions before they are committed to delivery
Reduces delivery risk by catching architectural violations before implementation begins

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

rule.description: The mandatory constraint or required pattern

scope.description: What the rule applies to (systems, environments, data classifications, etc.)

rationale.description: Why this is mandatory — often references a principle or compliance requirement

enforcement.description: How compliance is checked (automated scan, review gate, manual audit, etc.)

exception-process.description: How an exception can be raised (or 'No exceptions')
